description_zh: 调用DescribeRouteEntryList查询路由条目列表
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-route-entry-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --route-table-id vtb-bp1r9pvl4xen8s9ju0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRouteEntryList

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the route table to which the route belongs.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目所在路由表的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table that you want to query
parameters.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route that you want to query
parameters.name: route_entry_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route. Both IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR blocks are supported
parameters.help_zh: 路由条目的目标网段，支持IPv4和IPv6网段
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The name of the route.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: route_entry_name

parameters.help_en:
The version of the IP protocol. Valid values:

ipv4: IPv4.

ipv6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
IP协议的版本。取值：

ipv4：ipv4协议。

ipv6：ipv6协议
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The type of the route. Valid values:

Custom: custom route.
System: system route.
BGP: BGP route.
CEN: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) route.
ECR: Express Connect Router (ECR) route
parameters.help_zh:
路由的类型。取值：

Custom：自定义路由。
System：系统路由。
BGP：BGP路由。
CEN：云企业网CEN（Cloud Enterprise Network）路由。
ECR：专线网关路由
parameters.name: route_entry_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the next hop
parameters.name: next_hop_id

parameters.help_en:
The next hop type. Valid values:

Instance (default): ECS instance.

HaVip: high-availability virtual IP address.

VpnGateway: VPN gateway.

NatGateway: NAT gateway.

NetworkInterface: secondary elastic network interface controller (NIC).

RouterInterface: vRouter interface.

IPv6Gateway: IPv6 gateway.

Attachment: transit router.
Ipv4Gateway: IPv4 gateway.
GatewayEndpoint: gateway endpoint.
Ecr: Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.help_zh:
下一跳类型。取值：

Instance（默认值）：ECS实例。

HaVip：高可用虚拟IP。

VpnGateway：VPN网关。

NatGateway：NAT网关。

NetworkInterface：辅助弹性网卡。

RouterInterface：路由器接口。

IPv6Gateway：IPv6网关。

Attachment：转发路由器。
Ipv4Gateway：IPv4网关。
GatewayEndpoint：网关终端节点。
Ecr：专线网关
parameters.name: next_hop_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_result

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent request exists.
If a subsequent request exists, set the value to the NextToken value that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of route hosting. If this field is empty, the route is not hosted.

Valid values: TR, which indicates that the hosting type is transit router
parameters.help_zh:
路由托管的类型。如果该字段为空，即表示该路由没有被托管。

取值：TR，表示托管类型为转发路由器类型
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en: The list of destination CIDR blocks of routes
parameters.help_zh: 路由条目的目标网段列表
parameters.name: dest_cidr_block_list

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent request exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the route was last modified. The time is displayed in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
GmtModified.description_zh: 路由条目的修改时间。使用UTC时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

IpVersion.description_en:
The version of the IP protocol. Valid values:

ipv4: IPv4.

ipv6: IPv6
IpVersion.description_zh:
IP协议的版本。取值：

ipv4：ipv4协议。

ipv6：ipv6协议

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the route is available. Valid values:

0: Not available.

1: Available.

This parameter is returned only when the next hop type is RouterInterface
Enabled.description_zh:
路由是否可用。取值：

0：不可用。

1：可用。

下一跳类型为RouterInterface时返回该参数

NextHopId.description_en: The instance ID of the next hop

NextHopRegionId.description_en:
The region ID of the next hop instance.

This parameter is returned only when the next hop type is RouterInterface
NextHopRegionId.description_zh:
下一跳实例所在的地域ID。

下一跳类型为RouterInterface时返回该参数

NextHopRelatedInfo.description_en: The information about the next hop

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the instance associated with the next hop
InstanceId.description_zh: 与下一跳相关联实例的实例ID

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the instance associated with the next hop. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).

VBR: Virtual Border Router.

PCONN: Express Connect circuit
InstanceType.description_zh:
与下一跳相关联实例的实例类型。取值：

VPC：专有网络。

VBR：边界路由器。

PCONN：物理专线

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance associated with the next hop
RegionId.description_zh: 下一跳相关联实例所在的地域ID

NextHopType.description_en:
The next hop type. Valid values:

Instance: ECS instance.

HaVip: high-availability virtual IP address.

VpnGateway: VPN gateway.

NatGateway: NAT gateway.

NetworkInterface: secondary elastic network interface controller (NIC).

RouterInterface: vRouter interface.

IPv6Gateway: IPv6 gateway.

Attachment: transit router.
Ipv4Gateway: IPv4 gateway.
GatewayEndpoint: gateway endpoint.
Ecr: Express Connect Router (ECR)
NextHopType.description_zh:
下一跳类型。取值：

Instance：ECS实例。

HaVip：高可用虚拟IP。

VpnGateway：VPN网关。

NatGateway：NAT网关。

NetworkInterface：辅助弹性网卡。

RouterInterface：路由器接口。

IPv6Gateway：IPv6网关。

Attachment：转发路由器。
Ipv4Gateway：IPv4网关。
GatewayEndpoint：网关终端节点。
Ecr：专线网关

Weight.description_en:
The weight of the route.

This parameter is returned only when the next hop type is RouterInterface
Weight.description_zh:
路由条目的权重。

下一跳类型为RouterInterface时返回该参数

Origin.description_en:
The origin of the route. Valid values:

RoutePropagation: Created by automatic propagation.
SystemCreate: Created by the system.
CustomCreate: Created by a user
Origin.description_zh:
路由创建来源。取值：

RoutePropagation：动态传播源创建。
SystemCreate：系统创建。
CustomCreate：自定义创建

ServiceType.description_en:
The type of route hosting. If this field is empty, the route is not hosted.

Valid values: TR, which indicates that the hosting type is transit router
ServiceType.description_zh:
路由托管的类型。如果该字段为空，即表示该路由没有被托管。

取值：TR，表示托管类型为转发路由器类型

Status.description_en:
The status of the route. Valid values:

Pending: Being configured.

Available: Available.

Modifying: Being modified.

Deleting: Being deleted
Status.description_zh:
路由条目的状态。取值：

Pending：配置中。

Available：可用。

Modifying：修改中。

Deleting：删除中

Type.description_en:
The type of the route. Valid values:

Custom: custom route.
System: system route.
BGP: BGP route.
CEN: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) route.
ECR: Express Connect Router (ECR) route
